content_sections.heading: AIIMS Gorakhpur Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AIIMS Gorakhpur Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Gorakhpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 42 vacancies are available - 7 for Anaesthesiology, 2 for ENT, 7 for General Medicine, 4 for General Surgery, 1 for OBGY, 1 for Ophthalmology, 3 for Orthopaedics, 2 for Paediatrics, 2 for Pulmonary Medicine, 4 for Radiology, 1 for Radiotherapy, and 8 for Trauma & Emergency.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Gorakhpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Senior Resident posts at AIIMS Gorakhpur is 08-09-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 42 vacancies for Senior Resident posts announced by AIIMS Gorakhpur in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Post graduate Medical Degree in the respective discipline from a NMC recognized University/Institute. NMC/MCI/State medical council Registration is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts is 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in Pay Band: Rs. 67700/- (Level-11) plus usual allowances including NPA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/EWS/OBC category candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 250/-, and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Written Screening Test (if a large number of candidates apply) followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the provided Google Form link by the last date. Candidates also need to bring the filled application form, bio-data, original certificates, and payment receipt on the interview date.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for PwBD candidates?
faq.answer: No, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
